about: Stanley is a rural municipality in Manitoba’s Pembina Valley surrounding the separate cities of Winkler and Morden—not those cities, and not Stanley, British Columbia. Mennonite West Reserve villages such as Reinfeld, Schanzenfeld, Blumenfeld, and Reinland sit among farms along the U.S. border. About 9,000 people live in Stanley RM.
